t: Im lehattir hatztzitzit mibbeged lebeged vedin niqra hattallit
s: Im lehattir hatztzitzit mibbeged lebeged vedin niqra hattallit ubo t"z seipim: muttar lehattir tzitzit mibbeged zeh velittenam bebeged acher, veen bazeh mishshum bizzuy mitzva labbeged shemmattirin mimmenna, kevan sheosin miyyad bebeged acher:

Veim nipsaq chut echad mehashshemona chutin ap-al-pi shennishtayyer bo kede aniba — asur lekattechilla laasoto bebeged acher, deqodem asiyyat hachutin babbeged tzarik lihyot kol chut mehashshemona chutin arok y"b gudalin, kemo shennitbaer besiman ya:

Veim yirtzeh liqshor bachut shennipsaq od chut acher kede lehashlimah ley"b gudalin — hareshut beyado, veyakol laasotah bebeged acher apillu lekattechilla, mishshum dehaqqeshira chashuba chibbur gamur keillu hen chut echad mammash:

Bammeh debarim amurim shehaqqeshira moelet laasotan chut echad? Keshenniqsheru qodem asiyyat hachutin babbeged, abal im leachar shehetil hachutin babbeged nipsaq chut echad mid' chutin haarukkin velo nishtayyer bo kede aniba beinyan shehatztzitzit pesula — en moil lah letaqqeno al yede sheyyiqshor bo od chut, kevan shekkebar nipsela hatztzitzit eno moil lo lehakshirah, ella im ken oseh maaseh beiqqar asiyyat hatztzitzit babbeged, dehaynu sheyyattir hatztzitzit happesula min habbeged veyiqshor et hachut veyachazor vitileha babbeged bekashrut, abal im eno oseh maaseh beiqqar asiyyat hatztzitzit babbeged — en qeshirat hachut moelet kelum, shehare omra tora: "gedilim taaseh" — velo min heasuy kebar bipsul, kemo shennitbaer besiman yv"d ayyen sham:

Asur lehattir tzitzit mibbeged im en bedato lahatilan bebeged acher, mippene shehu mebattel bechinnam mitzvat beged zeh shemmattir otam mimmenna. Abal im eno mebattel mitzvatah, kegon shehu rotzeh laasot mehabbeged beged acher shello yihyeh lah arba kenapot, o shehu rotzeh lemokrah lenokri — muttar lehattir hatztzitzit mimmennu, kevan sheaz en habbeged bar chiyyuba — eno mebattel shum mitzva mimmennu behattarat hatztzitzit (velaken muttar lehattir hatztzitzit mittallit shel metim) (veayyen beyoreh dea siman shana). Vekol shekken im hu mattir hatztzitzit mimmennu kede laasot bo tzitzit acherim yoter yapim, o mippene shennipsaq echad meharashim vehu rotzeh lehatil bo tzitzit acherim shelemim ap al pi shehatztzitzit harishonim kesherim — mikkol maqom rashshay lehattiram ulehatil tzitzit acherim tachtehem:

En yakol liqqach hakkanap kemo shehu im tzitzit hatteluyim bah uletoprah bebeged acher. Vaapillu eno notel kenap habbeged lebaddo ella chotek chatikat beged gedola sebib hakkanap vetoperah im hakkanap shebbah shehatztzitzit teluya bo bebeged acher sheyyesh bo shelosha kenapot — asur laasot ken. Veim asa ken — hare hatztzitzit hazzot shehubea mibbeged acher — pesulim, shenneemar: "veasu lahem tzitzit al kanpe bigdehem", shebbishat asiyyat hatztzitzit al kanap — tzarik sheyyihyeh hakkanap mechubbar leiqqar habbeged, veaz poterin hatztzitzit et habbeged, abal zo hatztzitzit shehubea mibbeged acher, kevan shebbishat asiyyatah behakkanap lo haya hakkanap mechubbar lehabbeged zeh — laken enah poteret et habbeged hazzeh, ad sheyyattir otah min hakkanap veyachazor vitilenna bo leachar sheyyihyeh hakkanap mechubbar lebeged zeh:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen bachatika hahi shemmebi mibbeged acher shiur tallit shechayyebet betzitzit sheyyitbaer besiman taz, abal im yesh bah shiur tallit shechayyebet betzitzit — en tzarik lehattir hatztzitzit mimmenna kesheyyitperennu bebeged acher sheyyesh bo kebar g' tzitzit teluyim, shehare bishat asiyyat hatztzitzit haya hakkanap mechubbar leiqqar habbeged, dehaynu lachatika zo, kevan sheyyesh bah shiur tallit az hi niqret iqqar habbeged. Veen tzarik lomar sheim eno rotzeh litpor hachatika hahi sheyyesh bah shiur tallit bebeged acher ella rotzeh lehitattep bah lebaddah — sheen tzarik lehattir mimmenna hatztzitzit harishona, ella metil bah od g' tzitzit umitattep bah:

Tallit metzuyyetzet kehilkatah shechillequha lishne chalaqim ubekol cheleq yesh bo shiur tallit shechayyebet betzitzit venishar lekol cheleq tzitzit echad o shenayim venimlak lachazor uletopram kebarishona — en tzarik lehattir hatztzitzit velachazor velahatilam kesheyyitperem, shehare lo nipselu hatztzitzit bemah shechalequ hattallit lishtayim, kevan shehatztzitzit nisharu teluyin bachatikat beged sheyyesh bo shiur tallit veyesh bah arba kenapot, laken adayin shem tzitzit kesherim alehem, ella shennitparedu hatztzitzit zo mizzo veen haprada zo posaltan, shehare kol hatztzitzit shebbaolam metilin otan babbeged zo achar zo:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Shebbekol cheleq vecheleq lebaddo yesh bo shiur tallit shechayyebet betzitzit. Abal im becheleq echad mimmenna en bo shiur tallit, azay kesheyyirtzeh lachazor uletopram — tzarik lehattir hatztzitzit mehacheleq sheen bo shiur tallit velachazor ulehatil achar sheyyitperem, shehare hatztzitzit hazzot kebar nipsela beet shennechleqa hattallit lishtayim, mippene shehayeta teluya bachatika sheen bah shiur tallit vehi petura min hatztzitzit legamre, vekevan shekkebar nipsela hatztzitzit — shub enah mitkashsheret mimmela al yede mah sheyyitpor et shene hachalaqim zeh el zeh, kevan sheeno oseh maaseh begup hatztzitzit, [ve]hattora omra: "gedilim taaseh" — velo min heasuy kebar bipsul:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshechatak et hattallit lishne chalaqim mupradim, o shenniqra lishne chalaqim mupradim, abal im lo nitparedu [hachalaqim] legamre ella hem mechubbarim zeh lazeh meat, im yesh bachibbur hahu kerochab shelosha gudalim — hare hem keillu hem mechubbarim legamre velo nechlequ kelal, velaken kesherotzeh lachazor uletopram — en tzarik lehattir hatztzitzit apillu min hacheleq sheen bo shiur tallit. Abal im en bachibbur hahu rochab shelosha gudalin — hare hem chashubin kenipradim legamre, velaken kesheyyitperem — tzarik lehattir hatztzitzit mehacheleq sheen bo shiur tallit veyachazor vitileha leachar hattepira:

Abal yesh omerim shehatztzitzit lo nipsela kelal bishbil shehi teluya bachatikat beged sheen bah shiur tallit, kevan shehi teluya bakkanap kederek kol hatztzitzit hatteluyot bakkanap. Velaken im yesh baqqeren chatika hahi shennechteka o niqrea min hattallit shelosha gudalin al shelosha gudalin, shezzeh shiur harauy lihyot niqra kanap — hare hatztzitzit hatteluya beotah hachatika omedet bekashrutah velo nipsela kelal, velaken en tzarik lehattirah min hachatika velachazor velahatilah achar sheyyitperenna. Abal im en baqqeren shel otah hachatika maqom shehatztzitzit teluya bo shelosha gudalin al shelosha gudalin, apillu lo nitporda hachatika legamre min hattallit ella adayin nishara mechubberet lehattallit, im en beorek meqom chibburah kerochab shelosha gudalin — hare hi kemupredet legamre min hattallit venipsela hatztzitzit hatteluya bah, mippene shehi teluya bedabar sheen niqra kanap kelal, velaken kesheyyirtzeh litpor hachatika im hattallit — tzarik lehattir hatztzitzit happesula hatteluya bah velachazor velahatilah bah, o sheyyaaseh bah tzitzit chadasha. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kassebara harishona heki deepshar. Abal im i epshar beinyan acher, kegon sheotah hatztzitzit shennipsela nipsaq bah echad mehachutin venishtayyer bah kede aniba, sheap-al-pi shehi keshera, mikkol maqom i epshar lehattirah min habbeged velachazor velahatilah kemo shennitbaer berosh hassiman, vetzitzit acherim enan metzuyin kelal — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona:

Im nechtak o niqra hakkanap veniprad legamre min hattallit veen bo bemaqom shehatztzitzit teluya bo shelosha gudalin al shelosha gudalin shiur harauy lihyot niqra beged — yesh omerim sheoto hakkanap nipsal millehatil bah tzitzit apillu im yirtzeh lehattir otam hatztzitzit hatteluya bo ulehatil bo tzitzit acheret chadasha achar hattepira, mishshum deoto hakkanap kevan sheen alayv shem beged, shehare en bo shelosha gudalin al shelosha gudalin, laken en hattepira moelet lo lechabbero im hattallit. Veap al pi shehu mechubbar bo — hare hu nechshab kimporad mimmennu veeno nechshab biklal hattallit, vehatztzitzit hatteluya bo ena poteret et hattallit apillu hetil bo et hatztzitzit leachar shetteparo im hattallit, shehare en hatztzitzit teluya battallit kelal, vahare hakkanap hazzeh nechshab leachar hattepira kemo haggedil (sheqqorin liisat) shekkatub besiman ya sheen metilin bo tzitzit mippene sheeno nechshab mikkelal hattallit, veap al pi ken hu oleh leshiur shelosha gudalin uleshiur melo qesher agudal, ayyen sham. Veap al pi sheyyesh choleqin al sebara zo — mikkol maqom bemaqom sheepshar yesh lehachamir:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Shenniprad hakkanap legamre min hattallit. Abal im lo niprad mimmennu legamre, ap-al-pi sheen beorek meqom chibburam shelosha gudalin, mikkol maqom kevan shennishar mechubbar meat — moelet lo hattepira sheyyitperennu battallit sheyyihyeh nechshab al yede ken biklal hattallit. Velaken hatztzitzit sheyyatil bo achar hattepira — poterot hattallit hazzeh ledibre hakkol:

Venohagin litpor chatikat beged bekanpe hattallit, mishshum derob begadim apillu chadashim yesh bahen tepira tok shelosha agudalin lispat habbeged, velassebara harishona shennitbaer besamuk en lihyot shum chatikat beged tepura tok shelosha gudalin lispat habbeged bimqom hatalat hatztzitzit, laken notenin bimqom hatalat hatztzitzit chatikat beged shel shelosha gudalin al shelosha gudalin sheen bah shum tepira, kede sheyyihyeh hatztzitzit teluya al maqom harauy lihyot kanap. Vaapillu im hachatika hahi shennotenin bekanpot hattallit hi shel or — en bekak kelum, shehare hattallit shel beged ukenapeha shel or chayyebet betzitzit, kemo shennitbaer siman yod:

Im niqra kenap hattallit mehanneqeb shehatztzitzit teluya bo ulematta ad sepat hattallit, im qodma hatalat tzitzit bakkanap lehaqqera sheotah hatztzitzit hayeta sham bishat haqqera — keshera, ap-al-pi sheen sham shiur melo qesher agudal, mippene sheshshiur zeh lo neemar ella bishat asiyyat hatztzitzit babbeged, kemo shekkatub siman ya. Veim niqra venishtayyer kol shehu uteparah veachar kak hetil bo tzitzit — keshera, ap-al-pi sheen sham harchaqat shiur melo qesher agudal lebad mimmaqom hattapur, mippene shehattepira chashuba chibbur leinyan sheyyihyeh maqom hattapur nechshab keshalem legamre apillu lepi hassebara harishona shennitbaer besamuk, kevan shennishtayyer kol shehu shello niqra:

Im niqra hakkanap bemaqom harauy lehatil bo tzitzit, dehaynu tok shelosha gudalin lispat hakkanap ulemala mimmelo qesher agudal missepat hakkanap — yesh omerim sheapillu en sham ella qera mashshehu lo yitperennu bechut harauy letzitzit, kegon im hattallit shel pishtan — lo yitpor et haqqera bechute pishtan, raq bechute meshi o shear minim, veim hattallit shel meshi — lo yitperennu bechute meshi, veim hattallit shel tzemer — lo yitperennu beshel tzemer, ella beshel meshi o bishar minim, veissur zeh hu gezerat chakamim shemma yishtayyer michut hattepira veyannichennu sham bakkanap leshem tzitzit veyosip alayv shiba chutin, dehaynu shelosha chutin arukkin veyikpol kol echad lishnayim, vechut echad qatzar yiqsherennu berosh hachut shennishtayyer mehattepira, vechut zeh hu pasul, mippene shello nitva leshem tzitzit. Ulepi sebara zo, apillu en shum qera bakkanap raq shettoper sebib hanneqeb shehatztzitzit teluya bo kede shello yitracheb hanneqeb, veken hattoper chatikat beged bekanpe hattallit im hu toper bechut sherauy laasot mimmennu tzitzit lezo hattallit — tzarik lizzaher shello tehe shum tepira tok shelosha gudalin lispat hakkanap ulemala mimmelo qesher agudal missepat hakkanap mittaam shennitbaer. Ap-al-pi sheyyesh choleqim al sebara zo, mikkol maqom yesh lehachamir bemaqom sheepshar. Vaapillu lisbara zo en issur ella im ken toper bechut laban, abal bechut tzabua — en lachosh shemma yetzarepennu lishar chute hatztzitzit, deakshav en nohagim kelal laasot tzitzit tzebuim:
